The preview pane's header no longer squeezes its last button into a vertical column of letters when the pane is narrow.

- 0.81.0 added `c` (comment lines) to the header's buttons. In a narrow pane the file name and the four buttons no longer fit on one line, so `d: changes` was pressed to one cell wide and drawn one letter per row, and `o: browser` was pushed out of sight. When they do not fit, the buttons now move to their own line under the file name; a wide pane keeps the single line
- Line numbers in the source view (`c`) still land on the right line when the header takes two lines
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.81.1 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
